_doc: Keyword hints map each predictor to a physical driver category by its variable name (physical pathway), not merely by which file it lives in. Precedence: wind -> human -> flow -> heat; precip/rain are Flow even though stored in climate.csv. If no keyword matches, source table is the fallback: land_cover.csv->Human, hydrology.csv->Flow, climate.csv->Heat. Extend the hint lists if a variable has an unusual name.
